info.name: Adobe Lightroom Lightroom Albums Album Assets API
info.description:
API for creating and managing albums and collections within an Adobe Lightroom cloud catalog. Albums organize assets into user-defined collections. Supports listing, creating, updating, and deleting albums as well as managing the assets within each album.

Contact Support:
 Name: Adobe Lightroom Developer Support
